title: Native macOS Diablo II — progress
subtitle: driven by Claude · counts come from code, tests and Ghidra; estimates are marked with ~ · dashed = on branches, not yet verified

bars.label: Game.exe functions named in Ghidra
bars.note: original 1.14b binary; re-queried live from Ghidra (all 11,257 named; the last 22 Warden and module-loader functions were named 2026-10-09, a few names marked unverified)

bars.label: Hedged exe names re-verified against the decompile
bars.note: 1,187 confirmed, 71 corrected, ~20 unclear; ~355 left (server/client helpers, library thunks, game-logic rows) (~ estimate of the total)

bars.label: Original source files indexed
bars.note: every assert-string path mapped to modules and functions

bars.label: Source files studied in depth
bars.note: NPC, units, saves, packets, render, sound, combat, level gen, loot, AI, quests, trade, session, skills, hirelings, lighting

bars.label: Level generator proven equal to the real game
bars.note: mazes + Act 1 outdoors + exact Act 1 tiles + Acts 2-5 outdoor/preset generators all proven in Go against the emulator; on branches: all 70 maze levels (2,696 rooms) and presets 26/27/32/33/37/94/97 now match the emulator record for record (427 levels, 30,129 rooms, 0 mismatches), not yet landed

bars.label: Real .d2s save: read and write verified
bars.note: 9 sections read; whole file written back byte-for-byte (golem section unverified)

bars.label: NPC interaction features
bars.note: click-walk · greeting · menu · return greeting · vendors · gamble · identify · mercenary hire · quest dialogue ✓ (Act 1)

bars.label: Acts playable end to end (scripted play)
bars.note: Acts 1, 2, 4 and the start of 5 pass a scripted walk; the Act 3 playthrough is on a branch

bars.label: Levels walked by a verify scenario
bars.note: levels a scenario enters (lower bound, counted from scripts/verify.d); dashed = Act 3 playthrough branch

bars.label: Main quests with logic implemented
bars.note: all 27 main quests: states, triggers, rewards (Act 1, Radament and nine more driven in scenarios)

bars.label: Player skills with engine behaviour
bars.note: ~130 of 7 classes x 30 skills; Necromancer/Paladin/Sorceress/Druid gaps closed on a branch (+11), Amazon/Barbarian/Assassin in progress

bars.label: Monster AI archetypes implemented
bars.note: monai.txt entries with a Go think function (about 60 are stand-ins)

bars.label: Monster AI archetypes ported faithfully
bars.note: ~85: implemented minus about 60 stand-ins (estimate)

bars.label: In-game UI panels matching the original layout
bars.note: 14 panels; a layout audit covering 5 is on a branch, never run in a game; update: the layout was then run in a real game window on a branch (150 rectangles checked, 0 deviating) but that branch is not landed

bars.label: Item generation gaps closed vs the exe
bars.note: 11 of the 12 gaps closed and checked against the emulator (stat-list aggregation remains); not wired into every drop path yet

bars.label: Sound and music confirmed by a human listen
bars.note: menu music, NPC voices, footsteps, spell/combat sounds, ambient: each needs a person to listen (I can only check logs)

bars.label: Multiplayer playable through the game screen
bars.note: realm server + protocol exist and are tested; game screen not wired yet: lobby UI, walk sync, combat sync, trade

bars.label: Mac app: build, Finder launch with real maps, disk image
bars.note: app builds and launches with real maps (verified); disk image built but not tested by a human

bars.label: Real full verify green (scenario sections per job, real parallel log)
bars.note: scripts/verify_parallel.sh run 47389 (6 jobs): 74 distinct sections ran, 71 green, 3 red (Act 3 gate, skill bar, act travel); 4 of 6 jobs ALL CHECKS PASSED; 360 Go tests PASS, 0 FAIL; a landing verify of the combined branch is in flight (not counted until it finishes)

bars.label: Acts played start to finish by a human tester
bars.note: the real completeness gauge: you play each act in the app and report what breaks (0 so far)

v1.title: Game v1 complete
v1.definition: v1 = a person double-clicks the Mac app, makes or loads a character and plays Acts 1-5 single player (quests, items, skills, monsters, saves, sound) without hitting a blocker; multiplayer through the game screen and Hell-difficulty polish count too. The percentage is a weighted average of the measurable bars below; dashed = on branches, not yet verified.
